zh.headline: Anthropic 被美国政府强制下架 Fable 5 和 Mythos 5
zh.observation: 今日最值得关注的信号是 **AI Agent 安全危机全面爆发**：Langflow、LangGraph、LangChain 三大主流框架同时曝出严重漏洞，NVIDIA 紧急推出 SkillSpector 安全扫描器，Google DeepMind 发布系统性 Agent 安全框架。与此同时，OpenAI Codex 的 Record & Replay 功能标志着 Agent 从“辅助工具”正式升级为“自主执行者”，而 Perplexity Brain 和 FAPO 则分别从记忆系统和提示优化两个方向推动 Agent 自主化。**Agent 的“安全”与“自主”正成为硬币的两面——谁先解决 Agent 安全规模化部署的难题，谁就能赢得下一阶段的竞争。**

items.title: Anthropic 被美国政府强制下架 Fable 5 和 Mythos 5
items.desc: 美国政府以国家安全为由强制 Anthropic 下架其最新模型 Fable 5 和 Mythos 5，安全研究人员签署公开信反对此举。
items.value: AI 监管进入实质性干预阶段，影响所有大模型公司的发布策略

items.title: OpenAI 2026年Q1营收57亿美元，亏损37亿美元
items.desc: OpenAI 一季度营收同比翻三倍至57亿美元，但烧钱37亿美元，股权激励占23亿美元。
items.value: 头号AI公司盈利模式仍存疑，价格战可能加速行业洗牌

items.title: 诺贝尔奖得主、AlphaFold之父 John Jumper 离开 DeepMind 加入 Anthropic
items.desc: 继 Gemini 联合负责人 Noam Shazeer 出走后，又一位顶级 AI 科学家离开 Google DeepMind。
items.value: 顶级人才加速流向 Anthropic，Google 人才流失危机加剧

items.title: OpenAI Codex 推出“录制与回放”功能
items.desc: Codex for macOS 新增 Record & Replay 功能，用户演示一次工作流后，Codex 可自动重复执行。

items.title: 7000个 Langflow 服务器遭攻击，LangGraph 和 LangChain 存在相同漏洞
items.desc: Check Point Research 发现 LangGraph SQLite 检查点注入可导致远程代码执行，三大主流 Agent 框架均受影响。
items.value: AI Agent 框架安全漏洞成为重大攻击面，所有 Agent 开发者需立即排查

items.title: Meta 员工士气跌至20年最低
items.desc: Meta 内部直播中员工公开批评，CTO 承认 AI 重组糟糕透顶。
items.value: Meta AI 战略内部动荡，人才流失风险加大

items.title: OpenAI 推出 LifeSciBench 基准测试

items.title: OpenAI 发布 Deployment Simulation 方法
items.desc: 通过模拟部署来预测模型上线前的行为，提升安全评估准确性。

items.title: Perplexity 发布 Brain：Agent 自改进记忆系统

items.title: FAPO：多步 LLM 管道的全自动提示优化
items.desc: Cisco 开源 FAPO，使用 Claude Code 自动优化多步 LLM 管道的提示，在 15/18 个基准比较中超越 GEPA。
items.value: AI 自动调优提示，多步管道优化从手动变全自动

items.title: Context-Aware RL：面向 Agent 和多模态 LLM 的上下文感知强化学习

items.desc: 证明第一人称人类视频在具身预训练中可超越真实机器人遥操作数据。

items.title: Holo-World：统一相机、物体和天气控制的视频世界模型
items.desc: 从单张图像出发，支持显式相机、物体控制和可选天气指令。
items.value: 视频世界模型的可控性达到新高度，推动仿真和内容创作应用

items.value: 开源社区获得最强文本推理模型，百万 token 上下文可本地部署

items.title: NVIDIA/SkillSpector：AI Agent 技能安全扫描器
items.desc: 检测 Agent 技能中的漏洞、恶意模式和安全隐患。
items.value: Agent 安全从被动防御到主动扫描，降低供应链风险

items.title: OpenMontage：开源 Agent 视频制作系统
items.desc: 全球首个开源 Agent 视频制作系统，12 条管线、52 个工具、500+ Agent 技能。
items.value: 视频制作全流程 AI 自动化，开源可定制

items.desc: 单 CLI 工具，零 API 费用，支持 Twitter、Reddit、YouTube、GitHub、Bilibili、小红书。

items.title: headroom：LLM 输入压缩工具
items.desc: 压缩工具输出、日志、文件和 RAG 片段，减少 60-95% token 且保持答案质量。

items.desc: 将代码库索引为持久知识图谱，支持 158 种语言，亚毫秒查询，减少 99% token。
items.value: 代码级 Agent 上下文管理效率革命性提升

items.title: hunk：面向 Agent 编码者的审查优先终端差异查看器
items.desc: 专为 AI Agent 生成的代码设计的差异查看工具。
items.value: 填补 Agent 生成代码的人工审查工具空白

items.title: freellmapi：免费 LLM API 代理
items.desc: 聚合约 14 家 AI 提供商的免费层密钥，支持自动故障转移，兼容 OpenAI 接口。
items.value: 零成本访问多种 LLM，适合个人实验和开发测试

en.headline: US Government Forces Anthropic to Take Down Fable 5 and Mythos 5
en.observation: Today's most notable signal is the **full-blown AI Agent security crisis**: three major frameworks — Langflow, LangGraph, and LangChain — simultaneously exposed critical vulnerabilities, NVIDIA urgently launched SkillSpector security scanner, and Google DeepMind released a systematic Agent security framework. Meanwhile, OpenAI Codex's Record & Replay marks the Agent's formal upgrade from "assistant tool" to "autonomous executor," while Perplexity Brain and FAPO push Agent autonomy from memory and prompt optimization directions respectively. **Agent "security" and "autonomy" are becoming two sides of the same coin — whoever solves the challenge of secure Agent deployment at scale will win the next phase of competition.**

items.title: US Government Forces Anthropic to Take Down Fable 5 and Mythos 5
items.desc: The US government ordered Anthropic to pull its latest models Fable 5 and Mythos 5 citing national security, with security researchers signing an open letter opposing the move.
items.value: AI regulation enters substantive intervention phase, impacting all major model release strategies

items.title: OpenAI Q1 2026 Revenue $5.7B, Burned $3.7B
items.desc: OpenAI tripled revenue year-over-year to $5.7B in Q1 but burned $3.7B, with stock-based compensation alone over $2.3B.
items.value: Top AI company's profitability model still in question, price war may accelerate industry shakeout

items.title: Nobel Laureate, AlphaFold Creator John Jumper Leaves DeepMind for Anthropic
items.desc: Another top AI scientist leaves Google DeepMind following Gemini co-lead Noam Shazeer's departure.
items.value: Top talent accelerates flow to Anthropic, Google's talent retention crisis deepens

items.title: OpenAI Codex Launches "Record & Replay" Feature
items.desc: Codex for macOS adds Record & Replay, letting users demonstrate a workflow once and Codex repeats it autonomously.
items.value: AI Agent evolves from "coding assistant" to "autonomous workflow executor," enterprise automation barrier drops

items.title: 7,000 Langflow Servers Under Attack, LangGraph and LangChain Have Same Holes
items.desc: Check Point Research found LangGraph SQLite checkpointer injection leads to RCE, three major Agent frameworks affected.
items.value: AI Agent framework security flaws become major attack surface, all Agent developers need immediate audit

items.title: Meta Employee Morale Hits 20-Year Low
items.desc: Employees publicly criticized in internal livestream, CTO admits AI reorganization was "terrible."
items.value: Meta AI strategy in internal turmoil, talent flight risk increases

items.title: OpenAI Introduces LifeSciBench Benchmark
items.desc: Expert-authored and reviewed life science research benchmark evaluating AI's ability to handle real scientific tasks.
items.value: First high-quality life science AI evaluation standard, research automation assessment enters new phase

items.title: OpenAI Releases Deployment Simulation Method
items.desc: Predicts model behavior before deployment by simulating deployment, improving safety evaluation accuracy.
items.value: AI safety evaluation shifts from static testing to dynamic simulation, may become industry standard

items.title: Perplexity Launches Brain: Self-Improving Memory System for Agents
items.desc: Builds context graph of agent's work, learns overnight, improving correctness and reducing cost.
items.value: Agent memory shifts from "remembering user" to "remembering work," long-horizon task capability greatly enhanced

items.title: Adobe Embeds AI Agents Across Creative Cloud Suite
items.desc: Photoshop, Premiere Pro get AI assistants, shifting from content generation to production orchestration.
items.value: AI upgrades from "generation tool" to "workflow orchestration layer," creative industry paradigm shift

items.title: NVIDIA Introduces SpatialClaw: Training-Free Spatial Reasoning Agent
items.desc: Writes Python code to compose perception tools for 3D spatial reasoning without additional training.
items.value: Code as action interface, spatial intelligence Agent enters training-free era

items.title: Google DeepMind Releases AI Agent Security Control Roadmap
items.desc: Combines traditional safeguards and real-time monitoring to secure agent systems.
items.value: First systematic Agent security framework, provides reference baseline for the industry

items.title: FAPO: Fully Autonomous Prompt Optimization of Multi-Step LLM Pipelines
items.desc: Cisco open-sources FAPO using Claude Code to auto-optimize prompts for multi-step LLM pipelines, beating GEPA on 15/18 benchmark comparisons.
items.value: AI auto-tunes prompts, multi-step pipeline optimization goes from manual to fully autonomous

items.title: Context-Aware RL for Agentic and Multimodal LLMs
items.desc: Proposes ContextRL, improving long-horizon reasoning and multimodal performance through indirect auxiliary objectives.
items.value: Solves long-context reasoning bottleneck, improves Agent performance in complex scenarios

items.title: HumanScale: Egocentric Human Video Outperforms Real-Robot Data for Embodied Pretraining
items.desc: Demonstrates egocentric human video can surpass real robot teleoperation data for embodied pretraining.
items.value: Breaks robot data bottleneck, human video becomes new resource for embodied AI training

items.title: Current World Models Lack a Persistent State Core
items.desc: Points out world models need internally evolving states decoupled from observation, existing benchmarks have blind spots.
items.value: Reveals fundamental flaw in world models, points direction for next-gen architecture

items.title: Multi-LCB: Extending LiveCodeBench to Multiple Programming Languages
items.desc: Expands code generation benchmark from Python to multiple languages, evaluating LLM cross-language generalization.
items.value: Multi-language code evaluation fills gap, drives comprehensive LLM coding capability assessment

items.title: Understanding Behaviors of Environment-aware Information Retrieval
items.desc: First systematic analysis of how LLMs learn to adapt query strategies for different retrievers via RL.
items.value: New RAG optimization approach — teach LLMs to customize queries for different retrievers

items.title: ImageWAM: Do World Action Models Really Need Video Generation?
items.desc: Proposes image editing alone suffices for world action models, eliminating need for full video generation.
items.value: Challenges assumption that video generation is core to world models, dramatically reduces compute cost

items.title: Holo-World: Unified Camera, Object and Weather Control for Video World Model
items.desc: Starts from single image, supports explicit camera, object controls and optional weather instruction.
items.value: Video world model controllability reaches new heights, advancing simulation and content creation

items.title: GLM-5.2 Open Weights Released
items.desc: Z.AI releases 753B parameter MIT-licensed model with 1M token context, extremely strong text reasoning.
items.value: Open source community gets strongest text reasoning model, million-token context deployable locally

items.title: NVIDIA/SkillSpector: AI Agent Skill Security Scanner
items.desc: Detects vulnerabilities, malicious patterns, and security risks in agent skills.
items.value: Agent security shifts from passive defense to active scanning, reduces supply chain risk

items.title: OpenMontage: Open-Source Agentic Video Production System
items.desc: World's first open-source agent video production system with 12 pipelines, 52 tools, 500+ agent skills.
items.value: Full video production pipeline AI-automated, open-source and customizable

items.title: Agent-Reach: AI Agent Universal Information Access Tool
items.desc: Single CLI tool, zero API fees, supports Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, XiaoHongShu.
items.value: Agent information access capability massively expanded, breaking platform barriers

items.title: headroom: LLM Input Compression Tool
items.desc: Compresses tool outputs, logs, files, and RAG chunks, reducing 60-95% tokens while maintaining answer quality.
items.value: Significantly reduces LLM usage cost, supports library, proxy, and MCP server modes

items.title: codebase-memory-mcp: High-Performance Code Intelligence MCP Server
items.desc: Indexes codebases into persistent knowledge graph, supports 158 languages, sub-ms queries, 99% fewer tokens.
items.value: Revolutionary efficiency improvement in code-level Agent context management

items.title: hunk: Review-First Terminal Diff Viewer for Agentic Coders
items.desc: Diff viewing tool designed specifically for AI Agent-generated code.
items.value: Fills gap in human review tools for agent-generated code

items.title: freellmapi: Free LLM API Proxy
items.desc: Aggregates free-tier keys from ~14 AI providers with automatic failover, OpenAI-compatible interface.
items.value: Zero-cost access to multiple LLMs, ideal for personal experimentation and dev testing
